name: Segments of Exotics on Kalshi
description: Kalshi Exotics Market Analysis: Segments exotic prediction markets into combo-like (cross-category, multi, basket, index) vs. other exotics, measuring distinct market count, volume, and open interest by type.
query_sql:
WITH exotics AS (
  SELECT
    date AS day,
    report_ticker,
    ticker_name,
    daily_volume,
    open_interest,
    status
  FROM kalshi.market_report
  WHERE category = 'Exotics'
),
exotics_flagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(report_ticker) LIKE '%crosscategory%'
        OR lower(report_ticker) LIKE '%multi%'
        OR lower(ticker_name) LIKE '%basket%'
        OR lower(ticker_name) LIKE '%index%'
      THEN 'Exotics combo-like'
      ELSE 'Other exotics'
    END AS exotic_type
  FROM exotics
)
SELECT
  exotic_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT report_ticker) AS distinct_markets,
  SUM(daily_volume) AS total_volume,
  SUM(open_interest) AS total_oi
FROM exotics_flagged
GROUP BY exotic_type
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;
